about: Written by tools/director_manager/commands_json.mjs from tools/director/commands.js and tools/director_manager/words.js: don't edit it by hand

actions.label: Objective
actions.hint: the line the HUD shows as the player's goal

fields.label: Objective
fields.ph: Find the cellar key (empty clears it)

actions.label: Say a line
actions.hint: a line from the lines table, spoken with its take

actions.label: Think
actions.hint: the player's own thought, as a subtitle

fields.label: Thought
fields.ph: Her handwriting. Shakier than I remember.

actions.label: Ask the player's name
actions.hint: a box to type their name in; {name} in any line, thought or answer shows it from then on (game.player_name until then)

actions.label: Ask a question
actions.hint: 2 to 4 answers at the bottom centre under the question; each answer runs its own commands

actions.label: Add to the to-do list
actions.hint: a task on the HUD's list, ticked off in any order: by a trigger of its own, a Tick command, or failed (a time limit, a trigger, a Fail command)

actions.label: Tick a task
actions.hint: a task on the to-do list done

actions.label: Fail a task
actions.hint: a task on the to-do list failed: struck out in red, its “when it's failed” runs

actions.label: Take off the to-do list
actions.hint: a task (or every task) off the list

actions.label: Play a scene
actions.hint: a triggered scene: blended in from where the player is, then play goes on

actions.label: Set a flag
actions.hint: a named fact the story can branch on later

actions.label: Change a counter
actions.hint: game.counters: add to one (1 by default) or set it

actions.label: Karma
actions.hint: how the player treats her: plus or minus on an axis

actions.label: Light
actions.hint: one light, or every light in a room

actions.label: The power
actions.hint: the power cut: every electric light in the level dark (candles and fire burn on) and the switches dead, till a breaker (use: breaker) brings it back; or back on

actions.label: A car passes
actions.hint: headlights sweep across the room's ceiling now: a car passes outside its windows that have a sweep (a window's `sweep`; on their own every so often too)

actions.label: Someone's skin
actions.hint: a cast member's skin wet, sweating, dripping or oiled (0..1 each; left out: unchanged, 0: off): stays on her bodies till set again. The Godot export draws it; the desk's stage doesn't yet

actions.label: Flashlight
actions.hint: the player's flashlight (an item marked Flashlight in the Database): on, off, a flicker, dead (it flickers out and F only clicks) or working again (new batteries)

actions.label: Set a thing's state
actions.hint: a little thing to one of its states: the kettle on, the cigarette lit, the clock stopped, the phone ringing (docs/IMMERSION.md)

actions.label: A scare (trick)
actions.hint: the composites in TRICKS.md §2: a knock, a glimpse, a door slamming behind

actions.label: Someone's behaviour
actions.hint: what a cast member does in play until told otherwise: stand, sit, walk a route, patrol, or leave

actions.label: A face on someone
actions.hint: an expression from the library on a cast member's face (STORY_FORMAT §4): a capture plays once and her face goes back to the one she rests in, a loop runs until another takes over; as the face she rests in, it stays (none: at rest)

fields.label: as the face she rests in

actions.label: Close-up
actions.hint: the camera holds on someone for a line, then gives the view back

actions.label: Time skips
actions.hint: missing time: the little things live through it at once (a clock's hands jump on, the tea goes cold); nothing else moves

actions.label: Turn the view
actions.hint: the player's view eases to something and holds (keep it short)

actions.label: Chapter card
actions.hint: a title card over the dark (“Night 2”, “23:40” under it): the time of day changes behind it, the game autosaves; a sleeper wakes in their bed

fields.label: the time of day after it

actions.label: Level sequence
actions.hint: an Unreal level sequence by name (a title card on the desk)

actions.label: End the task
actions.hint: the task is over: the flow goes on to its next node

actions.label: Stalker (Unreal)
actions.hint: the old Unreal-side stalker; on the desk, use Someone's behaviour

triggers.label: The power is on or off
A door is locked
triggers.hint: holds while it's locked: the player turned its latch (a door's latch), its key not yet used, or a door lock

triggers.label: The player looks through a peephole
A thing is in a state

clauses: a fact (something done, or a flag)
a quest is the one on
